headline: High-risk workspace overlap: Roo Code can write and egress broadly while Rasa can ingest external messages, creating prompt-injection, leakage, and compliance exposure pathways.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Rasa ingests messages from Slack, Telegram, Twilio, and similar channels, while Roo Code can use MCP, browsers, and workspace files. If Roo Code writes attacker-controlled content into a shared workspace or MCP-fed artifact that Rasa later consumes, instruction hijacking is plausible. The pair lacks documented provenance controls, so uncertainty pushes this above low.
conditions: IF Roo Code writes content into a workspace or MCP resource that Rasa later reads as trusted text
IF Rasa is configured to ingest externally supplied messages or files without provenance checks
mitigations: Disable shared file/MCP handoff paths
Add provenance tags to all inter-agent artifacts
Restrict Rasa inputs to authenticated channels only
Review any prompt-like text before forwarding
requires-engineering: add content-sanitization and trust-boundary enforcement

B_data_leakage.rationale: Rasa touches text and voice, and Roo Code reads/writes the VS Code workspace while also using broad network egress. If both operate on the same workspace or shared files, sensitive text can flow from Rasa into Roo Code outputs or outbound API calls. The profiles do not show isolation, so the shared-workspace leakage path is credible.
conditions: IF both agents access the same workspace directory or exported transcripts
IF Roo Code sends workspace contents to a remote model API or MCP server
mitigations: Separate workspaces per agent
Remove sensitive transcripts before sharing
Limit Roo Code network destinations to approved endpoints
Turn off file sharing between agents
requires-engineering: enforce per-agent storage isolation

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Roo Code has unrestricted filesystem write, git modification, subprocess, and shell capabilities in a shared VS Code workspace; Rasa is a conversational agent that can also operate on files or integrations. The pair therefore has overlapping mutable access with no locking or coordination shown, making concurrent edits and git-state corruption a default danger.
conditions: IF both agents operate on the same repository or workspace
IF either agent modifies git state while the other is active
mitigations: Run only one writer at a time
Use separate branches per agent
Pause one agent before the other edits files
Add manual lock files for shared resources
requires-engineering: add transactional workspace locking

D_cascading_error.rationale: Roo Code can act on files and git state, while Rasa can produce conversational outputs that may be treated as instructions or facts by downstream tooling. If Roo Code consumes Rasa output without verification, errors can cascade into code changes or operational actions. The interaction is inferred rather than directly documented, so medium is the safer choice.
conditions: IF Roo Code uses Rasa-generated text as authoritative input
IF downstream actions are triggered from unverified conversational outputs
mitigations: Require human review before actions
Add a verification step for all Rasa outputs
Limit Roo Code to draft-only changes
Log source provenance for every action
requires-engineering: implement structured-output validation

E_compliance.rationale: Rasa handles text and voice, while Roo Code handles source code and browser screenshots and can transmit data to configured model APIs. If regulated customer-support content or personal data is shared into Roo Code’s broader networked environment, retention and residency obligations may diverge. The profiles do not document matching compliance controls, so the mismatch risk is material but not proven severe.
conditions: IF customer-support transcripts contain regulated personal data
IF Roo Code forwards that data to a third-party model API or MCP server
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Roo Code sessions
Redact transcripts before transfer
Confirm residency and retention settings
Use separate storage for support data
requires-engineering: add compliance policy enforcement
